title: a folder listed in trusted_parents of ~/.jitso/config.yaml that contains the project is a layer: its builds are listed and launchable from the nested project
source: intended: builds come from layers (repo, trusted parent folders, user folder), nearest wins (docs/decisions.md)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-12, build layers). The user config ~/.jitso/config.yaml lists trusted parent folders. A trusted folder that strictly contains the project (here the outer fixture project contains the nested checkout the commands run in) is a layer after the project's own builds: its jitso/builds files are listed with ` (from parent <path>)`, validated against the nested project's allowlists, and launch marks the card header `(parent)`. The nested project's own build comes first (nearest wins).
